dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: Sorry that you had to see that. I just... can't hold my homesickness back anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: I came to Inazuma as a representative of our merchant guild, but I got stranded because of the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: The merchant guild didn't want to give up on the business foundation that they have built throughout these years, so they forced me to stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I thought the lockdown would only last several months before it got lifted. I never expected it to go on for so long.

dialogues.speaker: Li Xiao
dialogues.text: I don't even know if my lover and my parents are okay back home or not, alas...
